description: The shape infra/ actually has, and the one thing in this file that is a PREDICTION rather than a measurement. Written in a chat session with no terraform on it, from the documented schema, and checked the moment tests/fixtures/timeline/generate.sh next runs on the devbox: if terraform renders a module-qualified address differently from what is written below, this case goes red and the guess is corrected before a cycle is ever launched. All four buckets are exercised at once — two nodes, a hidden group, and one address nothing claims.
